title: Chennai Deluge Reconstructed Demonstration (Dec 2015)
narrative: A low-pressure depression over the Bay of Bengal dropped unprecedented precipitation exceeding 490 mm over 24 hours, causing Adyar and Chembarambakkam overflows.

timesteps.label: Depression Onset
timesteps.summary: Initial rainfall intensification. Waterlogged roads in low-lying pockets of Velachery and Mudichur.

timesteps.label: Continuous Heavy Downpour
timesteps.summary: Soil saturation reached 90%. Pallikaranai marshland expanded beyond normal bunds.

timesteps.label: Reservoir Discharges & Canal Breach
timesteps.summary: Adyar river breached embankments near Saidapet bridge. Ground floor inundation in Velachery and Ram Nagar.

timesteps.label: Peak Catastrophic Deluge
timesteps.summary: Peak deluge. Complete road cutoffs in Mudichur, Velachery, and Saidapet. Mass emergency rescue initiated.

timesteps.label: Peak Rescue & Subsiding Phase
timesteps.summary: Rainfall eased slightly. Massive relief deployment, boat evacuations, and shelter distribution across South Chennai.
